'''Tommy Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Malmö Swedish Open]] on 4 August 2001 with Dark surgeon, according to Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2813">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ the-european-tour-2001], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 9 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-09-the-european-tour-2001d2813/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
